name: Dented Pocket Watch
flavor: Runs four minutes fast. You have learned to account for it.

name: Borrowed Wristwatch
flavor: It belonged to someone who is not asking for it back.

name: Railroad Grade
flavor: Built so trains would not hit each other. Works just as well on a still.

name: Jeweled Movement
flavor: Seventeen jewels. It does not drift, and neither do you.

name: Gold Hunter Case
flavor: Snaps shut over the face. You check it without anyone seeing you check it.

name: Dead Man's Watch
flavor: Still wound. Taken off a man who no longer needed to know the time.

name: Plated Chain
flavor: Gold for about a week, then green.

name: Brass Fob Chain
flavor: Holds the watch. Holds it badly, but it holds it.

name: Pawnshop Gold
flavor: Somebody's wedding money. The ticket expired in March.

name: Watch Chain and Charm
flavor: The charm is a tiny gold horseshoe. It has not helped once, and you still wear it.

name: Heavy Rope Chain
flavor: Eleven ounces. People quote you better prices before you open your mouth.

name: The Long Chain
flavor: Every link was added in a different year. You remember what each one cost.

name: Party Line
flavor: Half the county listens in. Half the county buys.

name: Drugstore Phone
flavor: Back wall, past the soda fountain. The pharmacist never looks up.

name: Private Exchange
flavor: Two rings means yes. Three means the road is being watched.

name: Switchboard Girl
flavor: Marcy on the night board. She connects your calls and forgets them.

name: Unlisted Trunk
flavor: A line that appears on no directory and no bill.

name: Ghost Line
flavor: A number that was never issued, on an exchange that burned down in 1919.

name: Vest Derringer
flavor: Two shots. Mostly it is the showing that works.

name: Hickory Axe Handle
flavor: Perfectly legal to carry. That is the entire point of it.

name: Army Revolver
flavor: Came back from France in a duffel and has not been fired since.

name: Cut-Down Shotgun
flavor: Rides under the seat. The sound it makes when it opens ends most conversations.

name: Chicago Typewriter
flavor: Fits in a violin case, which fools nobody and impresses everybody.

name: Nothing Personal
flavor: You have never drawn it. Everyone who matters knows you have it.

name: Rusted Flivver
flavor: Forty on the flat. Thirty with a load.

name: Mule and Cart
flavor: Slow, but no revenuer has ever pulled over a mule.

name: Reinforced Springs
flavor: A loaded car sits low and a low car gets stopped. These fix that.

name: Tuned Roadster
flavor: Bored out over the winter in a barn. It does not sound like what it is.

name: Armored Sedan
flavor: Plate behind the doors, glass an inch thick. Corners like a barge.

name: Company Car
flavor: Registered to a firm that exists only as a filing cabinet in Delaware.

name: Pasteboard Case
flavor: Holds money. Does not hold rain.

name: Canvas Satchel
flavor: Says mail carrier from a distance, which is the whole idea.

name: Leather Attache
flavor: Scuffed at the corners in a way that suggests years of honest work.

name: Banker's Portfolio
flavor: Nobody stops a man carrying one of these. They hold the door.

name: Locked Dispatch Box
flavor: Two keys, and you have both. The second one is for the look of the thing.

name: Clean Hands
flavor: Belonged to an alderman. Still smells faintly of his cologne.

name: Oilskin Coat
flavor: Smells like the river. Everyone on the river smells like the river.

name: Patched Work Coat
flavor: Four different men's elbows. Nobody looks twice at a working man.

name: Wool Overcoat
flavor: Heavy enough to hide a bottle in each pocket and hang straight.

name: Tailored Topcoat
flavor: Cut so the shoulders lie flat over whatever is under them.

name: Camelhair Chesterfield
flavor: Velvet collar. You get waved through doors you were not going to be waved through.

name: Nobody's Jacket
flavor: Grey, unremarkable, the exact wrong weight for every season. No one has ever described you in it.

name: Cracked Work Boots
flavor: Resoled twice. You walk the whole route in these.

name: Canvas Deck Shoes
flavor: Quiet on a loading dock, which matters more than they look like it should.

name: Resoled Brogues
flavor: Good leather, bad history. The cobbler asked no questions about the stain.

name: Wingtip Oxfords
flavor: You bought them to get into the Marquis. They worked the first night.

name: Custom Lasts
flavor: Made to a wooden model of your own foot. You could walk to the county line.

name: Dead Stock
flavor: Never worn, never sold, sat in a back room through the whole decade waiting for you.
